description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.
name: io.form/formio-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Pins every directory to one Form.io project (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). It takes precedence over the per-directory mapping and project_set cannot redirect it — set it only for a launch that must always target the same project, such as CI or a container. Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional. A project URL to offer, not to apply. When a working directory has no mapping, the server names it as the suggested project for the agent to confirm and persist with project_set. It never changes what a tool resolves — the opposite of FORMIO_PROJECT_URL.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_DEFAULT_PROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Form.io deployment — the parent of FORMIO_PROJECT_URL (default: https://api.form.io). Set this when self-hosting or using Form.io Enterprise.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — when omitted the server uses a browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
